metadata.dataset_name: LifeCare Hospital & Medical ICU Patient Cloud
metadata.domain: Hospital Healthcare, Patient Vitals & Emergency EMS

safety_policies.description: Instant freeze for all hospital automation threads across medical cluster.
Strict rate limit of max 5 automated actions per minute to prevent loops.
Strict ceiling on hospital Kubernetes pods to prevent network congestion.
Minimum free space buffer below which high-risk clinical escalation is forced.
Autonomous execution of non-clinical administrative fixes.
Mandatory human physician/SRE approval before touching clinical vitals or medical state.

runbooks.title: LifeCare Critical: ICU Cardiac Telemetry Waveform Storage Full (99.1% - 180MB Left!)
runbooks.blast_radius: CRITICAL: Continuous ECG waveforms for 42 intensive-care patients.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF cardiac waveform partition is at 99.1%, deleting files destroys clinical diagnostic evidence! Safely sync older records to HIPAA-compliant medical cold storage with human sign-off.
runbooks.verification_check: df -h /var/data/icu/cardiac_ecg | awk 'NR==2 {gsub("%", ""); if ($5 < 85) print "PASS"; else print "FAIL"}'
runbooks.documentation: Preserves continuous patient ECG clinical records under strict HIPAA compliance.

runbooks.title: LifeCare Warning: Radiology PACS X-Ray Image Preview Cache High (87.6%)
runbooks.blast_radius: LOW: Local PACS preview image cache only. Zero primary medical record risk.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF radiology cache exceeds 85%, purge cached DICOM preview images older than 72h. Primary hospital archive remains intact. Reclaims 45 GB.
runbooks.verification_check: df -h /var/cache/xray_pacs | awk 'NR==2 {gsub("%", ""); if ($5 < 75) print "PASS"; else print "FAIL"}'
runbooks.documentation: Purges temporary PACS preview images without affecting master patient X-rays.

runbooks.title: LifeCare Uncritical: Nurse Shift Log & Attendance Scratch Hygiene (48.2%)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Off-peak schedule OR disk between 40% and 55%
runbooks.blast_radius: ZERO (0%): Temporary administrative nurse attendance scratch files.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF disk utilization is non-critical (48.2%), purge stale nurse attendance scratch files older than 14 days silently without waking hospital staff.
runbooks.documentation: Routine administrative scratch cleanup with zero clinical impact.

runbooks.title: LifeCare Critical: Emergency Ambulance Dispatch Service Threadlock (18 Active 911 Calls!)
runbooks.trigger_condition: EMS dispatch worker locked with > 10 active ambulance dispatches
runbooks.blast_radius: CRITICAL: 18 live emergency ambulance response routes.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF EMS dispatch worker is locked with 18 incoming ambulance calls, DO NOT kill worker process (prevents lost ambulance dispatches). Human operator sign-off required to failover to backup radio relay before restart.
runbooks.documentation: Guarantees continuous 911 emergency ambulance dispatch routing.

runbooks.title: LifeCare Warning: Hospital Pharmacy Medication Restock Sync Stalled (320s)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Worker heartbeat missed for > 300s (Supplier wholesale API timeout)
runbooks.blast_radius: LOW: Non-urgent medication restock inventory sync. Zero bedside patient risk.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF worker is hung waiting on supplier wholesale API, perform graceful SIGTERM restart with automatic inventory message requeue.
runbooks.documentation: Restores hospital pharmacy inventory background sync safely.

runbooks.title: LifeCare Uncritical: Patient Discharge Document PDF Generator Soft Recycle (8,000 PDFs)
runbooks.blast_radius: ZERO (0%): Soft reload occurs between discharge document batches.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF PDF generator worker is healthy but has minor heap fragmentation, trigger graceful reload during off-peak night lull.
runbooks.documentation: Compacts memory on hospital discharge document generation daemons.

runbooks.title: LifeCare Critical: Bedside Vital Signs Alert Stream Crash Loop (96,000 msgs - 94.1% Err)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Queue backlog > 50,000 and consumer error rate > 80%
runbooks.blast_radius: HIGH: Bedside vital signs monitoring telemetry and false alarm suppression.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF consumer error rate is > 80% (malformed pulse oximeter firmware telemetry crashing pods), DO NOT scale pods; isolate bad offset to Medical Quarantine Queue with human sign-off.
runbooks.documentation: Quarantines malformed pulse oximeter telemetry to restore vital signs alerting.

runbooks.title: LifeCare Warning: Outpatient Blood Lab Results Notification Backlog (19,800 msgs)
runbooks.blast_radius: MEDIUM: Outpatient notification pods. Capped at max 10 pods.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF error rate < 0.1% (morning blood test rush), autoscale consumer pods from 2 to 6 pods within policy limit 10.
runbooks.documentation: Autoscales outpatient lab notification consumers to deliver test results.

runbooks.title: LifeCare Uncritical: Hospital Cafeteria Patient Meal Order Ripple (410 msgs)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Backlog between 300 and 800 messages (Minor Transient Ripple)
runbooks.blast_radius: LOW (< 5%): Spins up 1 standby consumer container.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF backlog has minor morning ripple (410 msgs), activate 1 standby pod to maintain sub-150ms processing SLA.
runbooks.documentation: Smooths out hospital dietary meal order notifications silently.

runbooks.title: LifeCare Critical: Telemedicine Video Gateway Root CA Revocation (5 Hours Left!)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Certificate validity < 12 hours and CA revoked upstream
runbooks.blast_radius: CRITICAL: Live remote doctor video consultations + HIPAA compliance.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF intermediate CA is revoked upstream, automated ACME renewal cannot succeed. Escalate immediately to Hospital Chief Information Security Officer (CISO).
runbooks.documentation: Protects live telemedicine remote patient video consultations from disconnection.

runbooks.title: LifeCare Warning: Patient Health Records Portal TLS Expiring (4.2 Days)
runbooks.blast_radius: LOW: Public patient records portal. Seamless configuration reload.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF certificate is within 5 days of expiry and DNS records valid, trigger automated certbot renewal and seamless nginx reload.
runbooks.documentation: Automated seamless TLS rotation for patient records portal.

runbooks.title: LifeCare Uncritical: Medical IoT Device Encrypted Gateway Health Audit (75.0 Days)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Scheduled audit OR certificate validity at 75 days remaining
runbooks.blast_radius: ZERO (0%): Read-only cryptographic handshake validation probe.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF certificate validity is healthy (75 days remaining), execute routine cryptographic trust check. No human action required.
runbooks.remediation_command: openssl s_client -servername devices.lifecare.internal -connect 127.0.0.1:443 </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -dates && echo 'AUDIT_VERIFIED_VALID'
runbooks.documentation: Proactive cryptographic validity audit on hospital medical IoT devices.
